title: Money & currency
body: US Dollar, no currency exchange needed. Cards are accepted almost everywhere in Sedona, including the local food spots below — this is not a cash-only town the way some destinations are. Tipping norms match the rest of the US (see Local essentials above).

title: Budget & daily costs
intro: Solo traveler, Comfortable tier ($150–300/day target from intake). Honest flag, done in the actual numbers below rather than a hedge: lodging + rental car alone run ≈$223/day — comfortably inside the target. Add food and it's ≈$288/day — still just under it. But add this trip's one splurge, the spa treatment, and the total for the week comes to ≈$1,963 over 6 days, or ≈$327/day — about 9% over the stated $300/day ceiling, not merely 'approaching' it. That's the honest tradeoff of the Day 2 spa pick, not a rounding error; the flights line below is also $0 (destination unknown), so a real home airport adds more on top. Figures below are sourced estimates (≈), not confirmed bookings.

items.label: Lodging, per night (Sedona, 3★ average)
items.note: ≈$173/night for a 3★ property; 2★ runs ≈$143, the town-wide all-hotel average is ≈$231 (pulled up by luxury resorts at $300–700+). Sedona is meaningfully pricier than a typical US leisure destination — shop early.

items.label: Rental car, per day (compact/mid-size)
items.note: ≈$39–44/day for economy/compact, ≈$57/day for a mid-size — recommended over rideshare for this trip (see Transit).

items.label: Food & drink, per day
items.note: Own estimate, not a sourced figure — mixing a casual local breakfast/lunch spot with one nicer dinner.

items.label: Red Rock Pass (7-day)
items.note: Covers parking at Coconino National Forest fee sites (Bell Rock, Cathedral Rock trailhead, and others) for the whole week — cheaper than the $5/day rate past 3 uses.

items.label: Spa treatment (Day 2)
items.note: ⚠ Own estimate, not sourced — L'Auberge de Sedona's spa menu (Deep Tissue, Swedish, Desert Flower, 60/90 min) doesn't publish prices online. Call ahead to confirm before booking.

items.label: Flights — round trip
items.note: Omitted — depends entirely on your home airport; the intake didn't specify one.
